timeline.summary: Man Industries approved a USD 70 million corporate guarantee for its wholly owned subsidiary MISIC in Saudi Arabia.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,053.13 Cr (+41.9% YoY), net profit ₹61.45 Cr (+122.6% YoY).
Man Industries reported no deviation in the utilisation of preferential issue funds for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.
Man Industries secured Preferred Manufacturers List (PML) approval from QatarEnergy for LSAW pipes, coating, and bends on August 14, 2026.
Man Industries submitted the transcript of its Q1FY27 analyst conference call held on August 12, 2026.
Man Industries bagged new pipe orders worth approximately ₹600 Cr, taking its unexecuted order book to ₹4,100 Cr.

Man Industries (India) Limited’s 38th AGM on September 25, 2026, passed all resolutions, including financial statements adoption, cost auditor remuneration ratification, and Section 185/186 limit enhancements, with unanimous shareholder approval.
